purpose: Teach: 脚光/全盛期/迷走/イジメ/争奪/自尊心/趨勢/再犯

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、注目の脚光を浴びた作家の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on a writer who gained a lot of attention, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Opens with his name as a gentle check-in. Measured pace. Genuinely interested—not testing, inviting him to share.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、芸能界の全盛期を支えたスタッフを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at the staff who supported the entertainment industry during its peak.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere. Small breath at the start. Steady pace. Voice carries a hint of focus—he's thinking through what he studied, not reciting.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、政策が迷走した時期の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You studied a time when policy went off course, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Pause after his name. Slower cadence. Genuine curiosity about what drew him to that period.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、学校でのイジメ対策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined bullying prevention programs in schools.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight emphasis on 'bullying'—showing this matters to him. Not rushed, but grounded. A touch more present than before.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 資源の争奪戦の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored the history of resource competition in your research?
lines.style: Alert, engaged. Leans forward slightly in tone. Warmer than reflective—she's following a thread she finds important. Natural cadence, genuine.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、自尊心と社会的成功の関係を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at the relationship between self-esteem and social success.
lines.style: Consistent, thoughtful delivery. Slight modulation when saying 'self-esteem'—aware of the weight of it. Calm but present. Finishes with conviction, not apology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、世論の趨勢を分析した研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your research analyzed public opinion trends, didn't it?
lines.style: Slower tempo. Warm but measured. A hint of recognising a pattern—she's noticing something about his choices. Thoughtful pause before the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、犯罪再犯防止プログラムを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined programs designed to prevent criminal reoffending.
lines.style: Clear, direct. Slight lift at the end—he's aware this is the closing exchange. Settled, honest tone. Not apologetic, but grounded in what matters.
